items: MacroTrackro now runs entirely in your browser: your food log stays on your device, with optional sync to your own private Google Drive folder.
New Stack tab: list the vitamins, supplements and pre-workouts you take, tick them off each day, and see every ingredient added up across products.
Stack check: warns when an ingredient is over its upper limit, underdosed, hidden in a proprietary blend, doubled up across products, or flagged by FDA or Health Canada, and lists common gaps.
New Guide tab: about 170 ingredients sold in North America, each with what it is for, how strong the evidence is, and the daily numbers that matter.
AI stack review (Settings): have an AI agent check your products against current recalls and safety alerts, and explain ingredients the guide does not know.
Themes, fonts, 16 more languages, export, import and 'Erase everything' are in Settings.
